name: agentdust
description: Guidance for using AgentDust's local process and disk reports.

interface.shortDescription: Guidance for AgentDust's local process and disk reports
interface.longDescription: Use AgentDust's local tools to inspect Claude Code processes and disk usage. Cleanup remains local and requires the user's typed approval. This skill package provides guidance only. It does not install AgentDust, connect ChatGPT Cloud to a Mac, or expose process cleanup remotely.
defaultPrompt: How do I install and connect AgentDust locally?

publication.release_notes: Initial skills-only package for AgentDust 0.3.0 beta. Provides local process review and disk report guidance without a hosted process-control service.
